I have enough to answer. Five distinct server-side enforcement sites, each verified with anchors.

h15.

Single-memo read gate (`checkMemoReadAccess`, called by GetMemo) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:55-66
List query visibility filter (`ListMemos` narrows VisibilityList by viewer) — server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227
Linked-attachment access check (`checkAttachmentAccess`) — server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:445-453
Memo-attachment blob serving check (`GetMemoAttachmentBlob` visibility gate) — server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:214-224
Mention-notification access rule (`shouldNotifyMention` helper) — server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:62-68
Email-notification recipient visibility rule (`canViewMemo` helper) — server/notification/email.go:313-318

The core viewer-visibility contract (PUBLIC readable by anyone, PROTECTED by any authenticated user, PRIVATE only by creator/admin) is enforced independently at each of these surfaces rather than through a single shared function — the read gate and the list filter are the two primary memo-read surfaces; the remaining three re-derive the same rule for attachments, mentions, and email fan-out.
